packageInfo.name: @h4shed/skill-underworld-writer
packageInfo.description: Three-use-case skill for fictional underworld narratives, fact-sourced true crime writing, and episodic podcast production, with PACER-informed fact-checking

characterCreation.description: Create detailed underworld character profiles with three-phase methodology

narrativeArchitecture.description: Build complex mythologies and narrative worlds for fiction and true crime

pacerIntegration.description: Integrate with PACER API for fact-checking real court cases and legal proceedings

podcastWorkspaceContract.description: Canonical cross-agent project/output boundaries, manifests, scaffolding, validation, and release evidence

segmentedEditorialPackages.description: Evidence/claim packages render reusable, runtime-validated podcast segments and channel-specific article segments from a shared source of truth

releaseBranding.description: Canonical Neon Underworld release artwork, changelog-driven release cards, and repository-owned release rendering
